app.name: Kairos
app.tagline: When to leave, to the minute.

empty.title: No route yet
empty.text: Add a route between two places, for example from home to work. Kairos then shows you when to leave.

now.title: Now

tight.minutes: Still reachable without the buffer: departs {time}, leave in {minutes} min.
tight.now: Still reachable without the buffer: departs {time}, leave right now.

now.unavailable: The timetable cannot be reached right now.
now.noTrips: No connection in the next hours.

directionNote.denied: No access to the location, direction by time of day
directionNote.unavailable: Location not found, direction by time of day

journey.title: Your connection
journey.transferTime: no time to change | 1 min to change | {count} min to change
journey.stopovers: no stops in between | 1 stop in between | {count} stops in between

pinned.label: Pinned trip
pinned.missed: This trip can no longer be reached.

rain.to-stop: Rain on the walk to the stop around {time}.
rain.from-stop: Rain on the walk from {stop} around {time}.

snow.to-stop: Snow on the walk to the stop around {time}.
snow.from-stop: Snow on the walk from {stop} around {time}.

empty.title: Add a route first
empty.text: Once you have set up a route, you can plan trips by arrival or departure time here.

plan.title: Plan
plan.failed: The connections could not be loaded.
plan.none: No connection fits. Try another time.
plan.pinnedToast: Trip pinned. Its countdown appears under “Now”.

routes.title: Routes

empty.title: Your routes will appear here
empty.text: A route connects two places, each with its stop and walking time.

routes.notSaved: This device does not let Kairos store data right now. Your routes are kept only until you close Kairos.

notFound.title: Route not found
notFound.text: This route no longer exists. It may have been deleted in another window.

editor.missingStops: First choose a stop for the start and the destination.

origin.label: Start
origin.title: Where do you start?
origin.text: At home, for example. With the address, Kairos suggests the stops nearby.

destination.label: Destination
destination.title: Where are you going?
destination.text: To work or to school, for example. With the address or the name of the company, Kairos finds the stops nearby.

walkHint.origin: From this place to the stop. On the way back it counts the other way round.
walkHint.destination: From the stop to this place. On the way back it counts the other way round.

where.label: Address or company
where.hint: Kairos suggests the stops nearby. The position stays on this device. Only this search sends it to the timetable, rounded to about 100 m.

position.unavailable: Your location is not available right now.

nearby.label: Stops nearby
nearby.loading: Kairos is looking for the stops nearby …
nearby.failed: The stops nearby could not be loaded.
nearby.none: There is no stop nearby. Search for it by its name.

errors.stopMissing: Choose a stop from the list.
errors.stopSame: Choose a stop other than the one at the start.
errors.returnBeforeArrival: The way back starts before the arrival.

lines.label: Connection
lines.title: Which connection do you take?
lines.text: Kairos recommends the fastest one each time. If you prefer to always take a certain one, choose it here.

fastest.title: Always the fastest
fastest.text: The connection that arrives first, on any line.

own.title: Choose your own lines
own.text: Only connections on these lines. Others appear as a hint when they are faster or when your line fails.

lines.loading: Kairos is looking up the next connections …
lines.failed: The connections could not be loaded. You can still save the route.
lines.none: No connections are running right now. Without a choice, Kairos considers all lines.
lines.all: Without a choice, Kairos considers all lines.
lines.uncovered: None of the next connections runs on these lines only. Also choose the lines you change to, such as the bus after the train.
lines.journeys: in no connection | in one connection | in {count} connections
lines.name: Name of the route

buffer.label: Buffer when leaving
buffer.hint: Kairos plans this much extra time in both directions. An earlier connection that only works without the buffer appears as a hint.

created.title: “{name}” is ready
created.text: From now on, “Now” tells you when to leave. For another trip, to the gym for example, just add another route.

schedule.label: Schedule
schedule.hint: For fixed times, at school for example. On these days, Kairos shows the last connection that gets you there in time, and from the time of the way back the connections back. Empty fields leave a day as usual.
schedule.copyMonday: Use Monday for Tuesday to Friday

placeField.noResults: No address and no company found.
placeField.failed: Search is not available right now. Check your internet connection.
placeField.found: Nothing found | One place found | {count} places found

stopField.failed: Search is not available right now. Check your internet connection.
stopField.found: No stops found | One stop found | {count} stops found

share.title: Share routes
share.text: The link holds no route. | The link holds your route. | The link holds your {count} routes.
share.qrLabel: QR code with the link to your routes
share.copyFailed: Copying is not possible here. The link is selected, so you can copy it yourself.
share.hint: Scan the code with the camera or open the link on the other device. For the installed app on the iPhone, copy the link and paste it there under “Routes”. Anyone with the link can see your routes.

linkImport.title: Add routes from a link
linkImport.text: Paste the link you created with “Share” on another device.
linkImport.invalid: This is not a Kairos link.

import.title: Add shared routes
import.text: These routes were shared with you. Routes you added from a link before are updated.
import.accept: Nothing to add | Add route | Add {count} routes
import.done: No route added. | One route added. | {count} routes added.

invalid.title: Invalid link
invalid.text: This link is damaged or incomplete. Ask for it to be sent again.

settings.title: Settings

location.label: Direction by location
location.hint: Kairos first shows the direction that starts where you are.
location.denied: Kairos has no access to your location. Allow it in the settings of your device, on an iPhone under Privacy & Security > Location Services > Safari Websites.
location.unavailable: Your location is not available right now. Kairos looks for it each time you open the app and shows the direction by time of day until then.

awake.label: Keep the screen on
awake.unsupported: This browser cannot keep the screen on.

settings.privacy: Timetable data: opentransportdata.swiss. Weather: Open-Meteo.com. Routes and settings stay on this device.

weather.label: Weather
weather.hint: The temperature when leaving and rain on the walks. For this, Kairos asks Open-Meteo with the approximate position of the stops.

update.available: A new version of Kairos is ready.
